chunks: We have tried them as We tried the owners of the garden when they vowed to gather its fruits in the morning.

key_terms.لَيَصْرِمُنَّهَا: surely they will cut/gather its fruits

ai.seo_question: What is the story of the owners of the garden in Surah Al-Qalam?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as a warning against *ghurur* (self-delusion) and the neglect of *shukr* (gratitude) through the omission of 'Insha'Allah' in one's plans. The sudden transformation of their garden into a barren field serves as a tangible sign of divine power, reminding believers that all sustenance is contingent upon God's will. This narrative underscores the importance of maintaining humility and acknowledging the Creator in both prosperity and daily endeavors.
